versions.description_html:
Learn how SPF, DKIM and DMARC work together in Microsoft 365 to stop email spoofing, prevent Business Email Compromise, and secure your domain.

Anyone with a laptop can send email that pretends to be your company. The email system we all rely on was built to move messages, not to check who the sender really is.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why Anyone Can Send Email as You
  • SPF: The Guest List for Your Domain
  • DKIM: The Tamper-Proof Seal
  • DMARC: The Rule That Ties It Together
  • What the Records Actually Look Like
  • None, Quarantine, and Reject in Plain Words
  • The Reports That Tell You What's Happening
  • The Right Order to Roll This Out
  • The Mistakes That Trip People Up in Microsoft 365
  • Recap and One Question for You

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM

  • Microsoft 365 Copilot Without the Hype: Adoption, Governance & Getting Your Tenant Ready with Paul Keijzers [MVP]
